title: Swempy's Swamp Romp
author: Mattie Rynkiewicz
problems: Row 5 "right left through" can't start from where the dancers are: A right and left through needs two dancers on each side.
Row 6 "square through two - neighbors balance & pull by right, then shadows pull by left (trail buddy) · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 1 and 2 are too far apart to balance.

Row 6 "square through two - neighbors balance & pull by right, then shadows pull by left (trail buddy) · pull by" can't start from where the dancers are: pass by who must be one of partner, neighbor, larks, robins; got shadow.
Row 7 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 7 "partners balance & swing · swing" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 1 "balance & petronella · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 1 "balance & petronella · petronella" can't start from where the dancers are: A petronella of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 2 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 3 "long lines forward & back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
Row 4 "right diagonal robins chain (to trail buddy)" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the right diagonal.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
Square through: each balance takes 4 beats and each pull by 2.
